training_note: This model was trained on the datasets listed in dataset_files. Schema compatibility with a store's data does not imply validated predictive accuracy for that store. Performance metrics below apply only to the held-out test split drawn from the training dataset. Independent validation on new retailer data would be required to assess generalisability.
target_definition: For each store and category, baseline is mean daily sales over days t-6 through t; future demand is mean daily sales over t+1 through t+7. A surge requires a complete window, a positive baseline, and future mean >= the configured multiplier times baseline.
threshold_selection_objective: Maximize validation F1; ties prefer higher precision, then higher threshold to reduce false alarms without sacrificing F1.
selected_model_reason: Logistic Regression (unweighted) had the highest validation F1 among the majority baseline and Logistic Regression candidates.
probability_calibration_note: Logistic Regression probabilities have not been explicitly calibrated (e.g., via Platt scaling or isotonic regression). The reported probability is the model's estimated likelihood of a demand surge, not a guaranteed frequency estimate. Treat it as a ranked risk score rather than a precise probability.

naive_baseline.description: Rule: Flag surge if sales_today is >= threshold above past_7d_avg

evaluation_warnings: Validation threshold tuning used only 35 surge examples; the selected threshold may be unstable.
dataset_provenance_note: Only the explicitly listed workbook files were used for training. Uploaded store data is used for inference unless explicitly selected in the training dashboard.
